sections.h2: Total ethanol offers run about 1.7 times the blending requirement

chart.title: Total ethanol offers, grain plus sugarcane, reach about 1.7 times OMCs' requirement
chart.sub: Ethanol offered for ESY2025-26, million litres.
chart.source: CareEdge-sourced tender data, as cited in the post.

sections.means: Grain-based producers alone offered 13,040 million litres against a stated OMC requirement of about 10,500 million litres.

sections.h2: Four named fixes each cut 1 to 5 psi of pressure drop

chart.title: Four named fixes each cut 1 to 5 psi of pressure drop; the other fixes vary by case
chart.sub: Pressure drop reduction per modification, psi.
chart.source: Campbell, Barletta and Golden, PTQ Q2 2023, via Digital Refining.

sections.means: Pressure-drop cuts of this size free wet gas compressor capacity without a full replacement, which the paper says to avoid.
sections.todo: Start with pressure surveys across piping segments, since field measurements are more accurate than calculations alone.
